# Kang Cai Smart Sleep

> Kang Cai Smart Sleep Co., Ltd. is an OEM / ODM manufacturer of adjustable bed frames, smart beds, adjustable mattresses, leisure chairs and bed bases for global brands, distributors and project buyers. Based in Shatian Town, Dongguan, Guangdong, China. The site is written for B2B buyers; unpublished specification values are shown as "Contact us for details".

## Products
- [Adjustable Bed Frames](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/adjustable-bed-frames/): Mattress brands, furniture brands and distributors adding powered adjustable bases to a range.
- [Adjustable Mattresses](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/mattresses/): Mattress-led programs, compact comfort collections and independent-living applications.
- [Smart Beds](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/smart-beds/): Contemporary bedroom ranges requiring a complete, clean integrated smart bed design.
- [Leisure Chairs](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/leisure-chairs/): Wellness, lifestyle and hospitality ranges adding powered zero-gravity seating.
- [Bed Bases](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/bed-bases/): Furniture collections and mattress-support programs that need slatted foundations.
- [All models](https://kcaibedtech.com/products/all/): every model with key specifications

## Buyer guides
- [Adjustable Bed Functions Worth Specifying in a B2B Program](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/adjustable-bed-functions-for-buyers/): A buyer-focused look at adjustable bed functions: which suit different markets and programs, and which to confirm with your supplier before quotation.
- [Matching Mattresses to Adjustable Frames: A Pre-Order Fit Checklist](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/adjustable-frame-mattress-fit-checklist/): How to check mattress type, thickness and bed-board size against an adjustable frame before an order is placed, and what to ask your supplier to confirm.
- [Approving an Adjustable Frame Sample: A Checklist Before Production](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/adjustable-frame-sample-approval-checklist/): What to inspect when an adjustable frame sample arrives, from motor and control behavior to packaging, so the approved sample can guide mass production.
- [138th Canton Fair 2025 Recap: Booth 4.2A08, Guangzhou](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/canton-fair-2025-recap/): Kang Cai at the 138th Canton Fair, booth 4.2A08 — electric adjustable beds, smart beds and leisure chairs for global B2B buyers, Guangzhou Oct 2025.
- [Choosing an Adjustable Bed Factory in China: What to Verify First](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/choosing-adjustable-bed-factory-china/): The factory credentials, product range, quality control and communication signals worth checking before you shortlist an adjustable bed supplier in China.
- [KD Series Electric Adjustable Bed Frames at Canton Fair 2025](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/kd-series-electric-bed-frames-canton-fair-2025/): KD-series electric bed frames at Canton Fair 2025, booth 4.2A08 — fixed, five-zone, multifunctional and disassembled designs. OEM from 20 pcs.
- [KR001 to KR004: Smart Bed Series at Canton Fair 2025](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/kr-series-smart-beds-canton-fair-2025/): KR001–KR004 leather-upholstered smart beds at Canton Fair 2025 booth 4.2A08, each paired with an electric mattress. OEM/ODM programs available from Kang Cai.
- [Smart Sleep Industry Trends: What the 138th Canton Fair 2025 Revealed](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/smart-sleep-trends-canton-fair-2025/): Six smart sleep trends from the 138th Canton Fair 2025 — app connectivity, Split King, zero-gravity, OEM automation, recliners, and SE Asia growth.
- [How to Source OEM Adjustable Beds from China: A Canton Fair 2025 Guide](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/source-adjustable-beds-oem-china-canton-fair/): How to source OEM electric adjustable beds at the Canton Fair — factory credentials, MOQ, motor options and what Kang Cai offers B2B buyers.
- [Split King or King? Choosing the Right Adjustable Frame Format](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/split-king-or-king-frame-sizing/): How split king and king adjustable frames differ in sizing, motion and packing, and how to choose the format that suits your target market.
- [Wall Hugger Frames: Buyer Notes on Clearance and Fit](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/wall-hugger-frame-buyer-notes/): What a wall hugger adjustable frame does, where it suits a program, and what to confirm about clearance and fit before you order.
- [Why Adjustable Frames Weigh So Much: Motors, Steel and Slats](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/why-adjustable-frames-weigh-so-much/): A plain breakdown of where adjustable frame weight comes from, including motors, steel structure and slats, and what it means for shipping and handling.
- [Writing an Adjustable Frame RFQ That Gets Comparable Quotes](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/writing-an-adjustable-frame-rfq/): The details an adjustable frame request for quotation should include, so suppliers can answer on the same basis and you can compare offers fairly.
- [YJ Series Leisure Recliner Chairs at Canton Fair 2025](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/yj-leisure-recliner-chairs-canton-fair-2025/): YJ001-A01 and YJ001-A02 powered yoga chairs at Canton Fair 2025 — V-shaped lift, one-touch yoga mode, leather options. OEM programs available.
- [Zero-Clearance Frames: What the Term Means for Your Range](https://kcaibedtech.com/blog/zero-clearance-frame-buyer-notes/): What zero-clearance means for an adjustable frame, which programs benefit from it, and what to confirm with your supplier before ordering.
- [OEM sourcing guide](https://kcaibedtech.com/sourcing/): step-by-step OEM / ODM sourcing process
- [FAQ](https://kcaibedtech.com/faq/): common buyer questions
